attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post. The quoted Adept slogan is labelled as Adept's aim, so it is not presented as his own claim.

semantics.note: Keeps the specific completed $350M raise, the goal of near-universal software access and the general hallucination caveat. This is a retrospective factual observation.

contract.note: Reading 'just raised' as the March 2023 Series B, the amount as the announced gross figure, and 'aiming' as an ambition is the ordinary reading. It is fair to the speaker.

evidence.note: A labelled reproduction of Adept's 14 March 2023 release. It confirms $350M of new Series B capital and the ambition to use every software tool and API. The amount is company-reported, which matches the contract's basis.
A reproduction of Adept's Series B blog post. It contains the 'supercharge your capabilities' wording Marcus quoted and restates the $350M raise. It frames universal reach as a goal.
OpenAI's March 2023 GPT-4 documentation says the model still hallucinates facts and makes reasoning errors. This supports the general LLM reliability caveat. It is not specific to Adept.

reviews.rationale: Adept announced $350M of Series B capital on 14 March 2023, two weeks before the post, and said it aimed to work across any software tool or API. Contemporary documentation from an LLM maker admits hallucinations and reasoning errors. No evidence shows a different amount or purpose.

attribution.note: Marcus's own view, stated in his own post. His tentative description of Hinton's and Musk's views is correctly left out of the claim.

semantics.note: Keeps his personal framing ('I don't see') and the 'immediate' horizon. This is a judgment about possibility with no deadline or threshold, so under policy it is hedged, possibility-level language and is not scored.

contract.note: The contract correctly declines to invent a time window or a threshold for 'rapidly and radically'. Any score would depend on interpretations Marcus did not supply.

evidence.note: A Self-Refine preprint from 30 March 2023 in which a model improves its own outputs. It does not show rapid, radical self-improvement of a system's underlying capabilities, so it neither supports nor contradicts the claim.

reviews.rationale: Marcus states a possibility judgment ('I don't see as an immediate possibility'). He gives no deadline, threshold or definite committed outcome. Possibility language is not scored under policy, and the evidence is context only.
